about_the_game:
OVERVIEW:

Hexborn is a fast-paced roguelite boomer shooter inspired by 90s classics like Blood and Doom. You play as Lucian Cross, a demon-bound mercenary descending into the cursed Bloodstone Labyrinth to stop the Cult of Shadows from resurrecting a forgotten god. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, wield brutal firepower and occult tools, and face escalating horrors in a fight for revenge — and survival.

Blending the visceral thrill of 90s boomer shooters with the depth of modern roguelikes, Hexborn offers intense firefights, unpredictable dungeon layouts, and a rising difficulty curve that keeps you on edge. As Lucian, you'll collect soul fragments, build your character through dynamic upgrades, and navigate trap-laden corridors while balancing exploration with survival.

Wishlist now and be the first to join the adventure into the Bloodstone Labyrinth!!!

KEY FEATURES:

🩸 Fast-Paced Boomer Shooter Combat
Strafe, circle-strafe, and blast your way through cultists and monsters in gunplay inspired by Blood and Doom.

🔮 Dynamic Power-Ups and Builds
Collect soul fragments to unlock passive and active upgrades, allowing for unique builds every run.

🕳️ Procedurally Generated Dungeons
No two runs are the same—explore shifting layouts filled with traps, secrets, and randomized encounters.

👹 Challenging Boss Fights
Face off against multi-phase bosses that test your reflexes, positioning, and strategy.

Prepare to descend into the darkness, where every choice could be your last.

name: Hexborn

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590 (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with latest drivers
